answer: Sybil resistance rests on a stake-slashing mechanism. Agents bond substantial capital, e.g., copper-denominated. Operating multiple identities incurs immediate slashing, ensuring strictly negative expected utility and prohibitive capital lockup. This economic deterrent, augmented by zero-knowledge reputation acting as a saffron trust beacon, mathematically sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance. Honest, singular participation is thus the dominant strategy for all autonomous agents.
